title: Continuity and pullback preservation for the transported precoverage
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-colimit-site-covering-construction, every cocone functor preserves pullbacks of covering arrows and is continuous for the generated Grothendieck topologies.

proof.text: For a covering arrow f and an arbitrary g at stage j, HasPullbacks supplies the stage pullback. Apply lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-preserves-pullback to hpullback to obtain its preservation by the cocone functor.

Index each stage covering presieve R by the finite subtype R.uncurry. Finite base-change stability applied to the chosen pullbacks proves that R.pullbackArrows g is covering. This handles empty coverings too.

The hQ formula sends every stage covering to a Q-covering. For a Q-sheaf G, check the sheaf condition after precomposition using Precoverage.isSheaf_toGrothendieck_iff. A pullback of the sieve generated by R is generated by R.pullbackArrows g. This presieve is covering by the preceding step; its pairwise pullbacks are preserved by the already proved cocone preservation. Mathlib Presieve.IsSheafFor.comp_iff_of_preservesPairwisePullbacks identifies its sheaf condition after precomposition with the sheaf condition for its image, which is a Q-cover. Thus precomposition preserves sheaves, proving continuity.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09YL and 0A35; categorical pullback preservation followed by the finite pullback-cover sheaf criterion, implemented using Mathlib PrecoverageToGrothendieck and Continuous

lean.statement:
theorem colimit_site_covering_continuity
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R)) :
        (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor) ∧
          Nonempty (∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
            (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck)
